sents.en: Venus is a planet.
Planets orbit stars.
Planets in our solar system orbit the sun.
sents.ko: 우리 태양계의 행성들은 태양 주위를 돌아요.

sents.en: Venus is the second-closest planet to the sun.
sents.ko: 금성은 태양에서 두 번째로 가까운 행성이에요.

sents.en: It is about 67 million miles (108 million km) away from the sun.
sents.ko: 태양에서 약 6,700만 마일(1억 800만 km) 떨어져 있어요.

sents.en: Venus fully orbits the sun every 225 days.
sents.ko: 금성은 225일마다 태양을 완전히 한 바퀴 돌아요.

sents.en: One year on Venus is 225 days on Earth.
Venus spins while in orbit.
sents.ko: 금성은 궤도를 도는 동안 스스로 회전해요.

sents.en: The spin makes day and night.
One full spin takes about 243 Earth days.
sents.ko: 한 바퀴 회전하는 데 지구 시간으로 약 243일이 걸려요.

sents.en: Venus has thick air.
The air traps heat.
Venus is the hottest planet in our solar system.
Temperatures on Venus can reach 870°F (466°C).
Venus has many volcanoes.
Other parts of Venus are flat and smooth.
Venus has clouds.
The top layer of clouds move about 224 mph (360 kph).
sents.ko: 구름의 맨 위층은 시속 약 224마일(360km)로 움직여요.

sents.en: This is fast for how slow Venus spins.
sents.ko: 금성이 느리게 회전하는 것에 비하면 아주 빠른 거예요.

sents.en: Venus is brighter than any other planet.
Its clouds reflect light.
You can see Venus from Earth at night.
sents.ko: 밤에 지구에서 금성을 볼 수 있어요.

sents.en: Oh, the story is done already.
Venus is the brightest planet in the sky.
It is also a similar size to Earth.
What else do you remember?
Okay. Let's look for Venus together.
You're ready? Venus!
